standard.summary: 一切正常时学习率倍率的目标值（倍率会慢慢回到它）。
standard.effect: 默认 1.0 = 不干预。保持 1.0 即可，除非你明确想让整个训练在缩放后的学习率上跑。
standard.avoidWhen: 设成非 1 倍率会让全训练都跑在缩放后的学习率上。

standard_en.summary: The lr multiplier the Pilot relaxes toward when everything looks normal.
standard_en.effect: Default 1.0 = no intervention. Keep 1.0 unless you deliberately want the whole run scaled.
standard_en.avoidWhen: A non-1 value scales the entire run.
